sentences.text: The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the accused-petitioner for quashing of FIR No.03/2023 registered at P.S.Bhaniyana, Distt. Jaisalmer for offence under Sections 420, 406 of IPC.
After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the material available on record, I am not inclined to quash the FIR.

However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to file representation before the concerned Superintendent of Police and the Investigating Officer within a period of two weeks from today, who shall consider all the facts as well as contentions raised in the representation and complete the investigation strictly in accordance with law.
[2023/RJJD/007213] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-1189/2023] The instant misc. petition is disposed of accordingly.
Stay application is also decided accordingly.
